description: Put a copy of an entity template (this account's, or a public one) into a project: every member with fresh ids, its positions and colours as saved, bound to a new Entity that starts DORMANT (started: false: its code, sounds and physics wait until r3_component_set sets started: true), or awake with started: true (its code, sounds and physics run at once). The copy remembers the template and version it came from. version imports an older version. Answers the new Entity's entityRef and its members' entityRefs. r3_editor_undo takes it back.

projectId.description: The project to put the copy into.

started.description: true: the copy runs at once (code, sounds, physics). Default false: dormant, woken later with r3_component_set {started: true}.

version.description: A version to import (default: the current one).

name: r3_entity_import

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: Import an entity template into a project
